description: This file contains unit tests for TalkModeManager, specifically testing the detection of PCM format rejection errors and handling of playback failures within the TalkModeManager component.

classes.name: TalkModeManagerTests
classes.description: Test suite for TalkModeManager focusing on error detection and handling behaviors.

methods.name: detectsPCMFormatRejectionFromElevenLabsError
methods.description: Test that verifies the PCM format rejection is correctly identified when an error with ElevenLabsTTS domain and 403 code occurs.

methods.name: ignoresGenericPlaybackFailuresForPCMFormatRejection
methods.description: Test that verifies playback failures unrelated to PCM format rejection are handled appropriately, returning false for the rejection check.
